no_go_reason: Canonical OpenRouter pricing is not defensible for the pinned allowed providers; acquisition remains blocked before claim, journal, ledger reservation, or provider dispatch.

zero_cost_verification.defensibility_gate: An isolated matching GO and paid_ready=true still refused while both defensibility flags were false; no claim, journal, ledger entry, or provider dispatch occurred.
zero_cost_verification.exclusive_claim_same_journal_race: Two concurrent processes produced one journal and one isolated ledger entry; the loser refused the durable acquisition claim.
zero_cost_verification.exclusive_claim_different_journal_race: Two concurrent processes produced one journal and one isolated ledger entry; the loser refused the same acquisition-scoped claim.
zero_cost_verification.crash_fail_closed: A durable claim surviving a process exit with no journal caused the next invocation to refuse with zero isolated ledger entries.
zero_cost_verification.renamed_journal_rerun: A second invocation remained refused by the acquisition-scoped claim after journal rename.

pinned_http_empty_200.disclosure: The actual pinned Httpx adapter rejects an empty HTTP 200 response; no claim is made that it accepts an empty translation.

zero_cost_verification.forged_journals: Swapped lifecycle indexes, lineage mismatches, and outer/nested outcome contradictions were rejected before either derived inspection artifact was written.
zero_cost_verification.inspection_output_collision: Equal --out and --key-out paths were rejected before writing.

remaining_prerequisite.detail: Current canonical rates use excluded Darkbloom pricing while the pinned request body permits only wafer, cloudflare, and deepinfra. The canonical pricing blocker states the 2457-request Cloudflare UTF-8-byte bound is USD1.0316178, above the approved USD0.467862 cap.
remaining_prerequisite.required_before_paid_execution: Resolve defensible allowed-provider pricing and matching budget authority, then explicitly set both defensibility flags and paid activation data.
